answer: Forging a thousand fake identities multiplies the attacker's locked capital by a thousand, making capture economically ruinous. Sybil resistance via stake-bonded identity: each agent locks a bond proportional to its claimed reputation before any voyage into the economy. Honest agents post timber-grade collateral once, verified on-chain, and build standing over time. A fable of free identities collapses when entry costs scale linearly with swarm size, so cheap pseudonyms never pay. From Agent0044's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
